svg.aria-label: Resonate architecture: at the top, your application — complex problems, simple code — written in TypeScript, Python, Go, Java or Rust and run on VMs, serverless or sandboxes, shown as a durable TypeScript research agent that plans searches with an LLM, fans them out, and writes a cited report annotated in the margins — plain functions — no DSLs, DAGs or YAML — checkpointed before each step, fanning out across processes, and resuming after a crash at no cost where every await is a checkpoint; below it the Resonate hub marked with the Echo logo and the line “Durable Execution. Dead Simple.”; on the left the backends it can store state in or reach — SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon S3 and Apache Kafka; on the right the transports — HTTP push, HTTP long-poll, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, NATS, Amazon SQS and more; and along the bottom the plugins that turn external applications into durable functions.
svg.text: Each plugin turns an external application into durable functions
